map.送风量 L = Q / ( ρ × c: Supply air volume L = Q / ( ρ × c
map.Q — 室内冷负荷 (W) | ρ — 空气密度: Q — indoor cooling load (W) | ρ — air density
map.换气次数 n = L / V | 送风口数量 = ⌈ L(m³/h) / 500: Air changes n = L / V | supply outlets = ⌈ L(m³/h) / 500 ⌉
map.面积 × 层高，如 40m²×3m: Area × floor height, e.g. 40 m²×3 m
map.按主风管风速 6-10 m/s、支风管风速 4-6 m/s 推荐风管截面积与等效: Recommend duct area and equivalent diameter at main-duct velocity 6–10 m/s and branch-duct velocity 4–6 m/s.
map.风管截面积 A = L(m³/s) / v；等效圆形风管直径 d = √(4A/: Duct area A = L(m³/s) / v; equivalent circular diameter d = √(4A/π). Actual engineering must combine noise control, resistance and rectangular aspect ratio comprehensively.
map.📋 不同送风温差风量对比: 📋 Airflow comparison at different supply temperature differences
map.相同冷负荷下，送风温差越大所需风量越小（节能但需注意温度梯度与吹风感）。: At the same cooling load, a larger supply temperature difference needs less airflow (energy-saving but watch temperature gradient and draft sensation).
map.n < 5 次/h：偏低，可能换气不足、温度分布不均: n < 5 ACH/h: low, possible insufficient ventilation and uneven temperature distribution
map.5 ≤ n ≤ 10 次/h：适宜，常规舒适空调推荐区间: 5 ≤ n ≤ 10 ACH/h: suitable, the recommended range for conventional comfort AC
map.10 < n ≤ 15 次/h：偏高，注意气流组织与噪声控制: 10 < n ≤ 15 ACH/h: high, watch air distribution and noise control
map.n > 15 次/h：过高，建议增大送风温差以降低风量: n > 15 ACH/h: too high, recommend increasing the supply temperature difference to reduce airflow
map.送风口颈部风速：2-5 m/s（依风口型式而定）: Supply outlet neck velocity: 2–5 m/s (depends on outlet type)
map.风速过高会增加噪声与阻力，过低则风管截面偏大、占地多: Too high velocity increases noise and resistance; too low makes the duct section large and space-consuming
map.温差过大会导致工作区温度梯度大、产生吹风感: Too large a difference causes a large working-zone temperature gradient and draft sensation

map.按房间体积与换气次数反推所需送风量。: Back-calculate the required supply airflow from room volume and air changes.
map.由送风温差算显热送风量，校核风口数量与单口风量。: From the supply temperature difference compute the sensible supply airflow, and check outlet count and per-outlet airflow.
map.对比不同换气次数下的能耗与舒适度。: Compare energy and comfort at different air-changes.
map.送风量 L = 2500×8 = 20000 m³/h；若送风温差 8℃ 则显热: Supply airflow L = 2500×8 = 20000 m³/h; if the supply temperature difference is 8°C the sensible airflow is computed separately, with outlets sized at 1000 m³/h each for about 20 outlets.
map.总风量 20000 ÷ 单口 1000 = 20 个送风口，布置需均匀避免短路与: Total airflow 20000 ÷ 1000 per outlet = 20 supply outlets, arranged evenly to avoid short-circuiting and dead zones.
map.换气次数取多少？: How many air changes to take?
map.按房间用途：办公室 6~10、实验室/药房更高，参考洁净度与人员密度。: By room use: office 6–10, lab/pharmacy higher; refer to cleanliness and occupancy density.
map.送风温差大好还是小好？: Is a larger or smaller supply temperature difference better?
map.大温差省风量但易吹风感，小温差舒适但风量大占地多，按舒适度与空间权衡。: Larger difference saves airflow but risks draft; smaller is comfortable but larger airflow and footprint; trade off by comfort and space.
